_help: The hotkey bar (HUD, bottom right): one cell per game action. x/y = the top-left of the first cell in 1366x768 game pixels. cellW/cellH = the cell box (the official strip is 557x67: 16 cells of a 32x32 frame with a 3px gap, so one cell is cut from (0,0,35,33) and the pitch is 35), pitch = the distance between two cells. capDy = the key cap in the cell (the cap is centred in the cell), nameDy = the action name under the cap.
